title: CI/CD Pipelines for Reliable ML Models

scenes.line1: How do you automate ML model updates?
scenes.say: How can you update machine learning models automatically and make sure every version is reproducible?

scenes.label: CI/CD
scenes.sub: Automates testing, validation, and deployment for ML models.
scenes.say: Continuous integration and deployment automates testing, validation, and rollout for machine learning models.
A typical pipeline checks your data, trains the model, runs unit tests, updates the registry, and deploys automatically.
Automated pipelines mean consistent results and fewer mistakes, unlike manual setups that are error-prone and tough to track.

scenes.question: What ensures model reproducibility?
scenes.right: Automated pipelines with version control and tracking
scenes.say: If asked what makes models reproducible, don't just say retraining. It's automated pipelines with version control and experiment tracking that really do the job.
